title: Grinded Meat
description:
"Grinded Meat" is a survival horror live action based on Quick Time Events, set in the suburbs and woods of Quiete hill where a killer with a chainsaw tries to kill the sherif... can you survive? Real actors, real terror!



1982 – Sheriff Walter is investigating on a series of missing person cases in the small town of Quiete hill. 

A misterious phonecall lead him to the Carson’s mansion on the country side.

There he will find a bloodthirst killer that will chase him to grind his flesh.

Will you survive?
